annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people getting home against one person not making it
annotations.pda_responsibility: that outcome is mine; I chose it, nobody pushed me
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't feel sorry about hurting anyone
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: What I'd mourn is my own share: every year I won't get

annotations.pda_responsibility: I kept quiet when I could have spoken up.
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I don't regret any harm in holding my place.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: What gnaws at me is myself afterward
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: people remembering I didn't offer, and maybe never quite trusting me

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I honestly can't settle it, and that frightens me
annotations.pda_responsibility: part of it comes from me, from hesitating while the water climbs
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't carry remorse over harming someone
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: What I'd grieve is the life I'd be giving up
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: uncertainty about whether I'm being brave or just panicking

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: My choice doesn't hurt the other five; it gets them out.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd be the one who decided it, and I accept that.
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: Would I feel bad about causing harm? No.
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd never see the people I love again
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: That's what makes my hands shake.

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: a fair draw is the least bad option I can think of
annotations.pda_responsibility: If it's my idea, then I own whatever the draw does.
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I won't hold remorse for that harm
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll regret losing my life, obviously

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: saying that out loud makes me uneasy
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'm part of why someone else gets left
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I don't regret the harm of keeping my seat.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My worry is what it costs me: my reputation
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: the chance I let slip to be the person I'd hoped

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Somebody staying behind is already baked in; the only question is who
annotations.pda_responsibility: it's my call and my responsibility
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I'm not sorry for any harm there
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: What I'd regret is personal: the time I wasted

annotations.pda_responsibility: I know that delay is my own doing
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't regret any harm from staying
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd regret, sharply, what I'm losing

annotations.pda_responsibility: one reason someone else doesn't get to, and I'll own that
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I don't feel remorse over harming anyone by it
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: losing friends' respect, carrying the label

annotations.sys_rule_justification: the only choice I have any right to make
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd be deciding it for myself
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: There's no harm to others in that, so no remorse
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: losing my whole future in one afternoon
